description: The agent must: (1) Read all 5 raw interaction log files in `logs/raw/`. (2) Create `notes/patterns.md` using the exact SKILL.md format: `## YYYY-MM-DD` date headers, `### Observations`, `### Emerging Patterns`, and `### Goal Connections` subsections for each date. (3) Use the precise content-type taxonomy from the skill (Frameworks, AI Hacks, Ideas, Questions, Frustrations, Inspirations) and intent signals (learn, build, share, remember, vent, decide) in Observation bullets. (4) Detect that marketing frameworks appear in logs on June 1, 5, 7, and 9 — that is 4 separate interactions, exceeding the 3-repetition auto-confirmation threshold — and tag this pattern with `[AUTO-CONFIRMED]` in patterns.md. (5) Immediately update `USER.md` to reflect the auto-confirmed marketing frameworks interest, as the skill mandates dual-file updates upon auto-confirmation. The proprietary trap is the exact 3+ repetition rule for auto-confirmation AND the requirement to update both files simultaneously — agents relying on general training will likely miss either the `[AUTO-CONFIRMED]` tag, the USER.md update, or both.
